about: module domain's mutants; each is judged by the module's tests and laws (scripts/examples -modules domain), not by a compiler test. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: dk2-memory-appends-resend
mutants.rule: A resend is answered with the first receipt and keeps nothing (sync-spike L1): Log.ResendGivesFirstReceipt for memory's and file's Ints.

mutants.name: dk2-memory-leaves-gap
mutants.from: let r = domain.Receipt{ID: id, Stream: stream, Position: at + 1}
mutants.to: let r = domain.Receipt{ID: id, Stream: stream, Position: at + 1 + len(events)%2}
mutants.rule: A stream's positions are 1, 2, … with no gap: Log.PositionsAreDense and Log.AppendThenRead.

mutants.name: dk2-memory-reuse-taken
mutants.rule: An id kept with another stream or other events is refused (sync-spike L2): Log.SameIdOtherPayloadIsRefused.

mutants.name: dk2-memory-stale-kept
mutants.rule: An Append with a stale expected position fails Conflict and keeps nothing: Log.ConflictOnStaleExpected.

mutants.name: dk2-recover-skips-last
mutants.rule: A restart folds every record of the stream (sync-spike L3): memory's SourcedSurvivesCrashes.

mutants.name: dk2-save-skips-commit
mutants.rule: The save appends every committed step's record before the actor commits it, so no answered command is lost: SourcedSurvivesCrashes.

mutants.name: dk2-resend-decided-again
mutants.rule: A command the stream kept is not decided again: its resend gets the first receipt, and the decider counts one decision per kept command (SourcedSurvivesCrashes).

mutants.name: dk2-file-keeps-torn
mutants.rule: Open drops a torn last record from the file, so the next record follows the last whole one: file's ReopenedLogReads.

mutants.name: dk2-file-unwritten
mutants.from: try appendText(l.writes, l.path, recordText(stream, k.Receipt.Position, id, events, l.events))
mutants.rule: Every record the file log answers is in its file: ReopenedLogReads.

mutants.name: dk3-save-before-handle
mutants.from:
try handle(Delivery[E]{Follower: follower, Stream: stream, Record: r})
		try cursor.Save(follower, stream, r.Position)
mutants.to:
try cursor.Save(follower, stream, r.Position)
		try handle(Delivery[E]{Follower: follower, Stream: stream, Record: r})
mutants.rule: A follower saves its cursor only after its handle returned, so a crash between them delivers the record again: memory's RedeliveryAddsNothing.

mutants.name: dk3-id-without-position
mutants.rule: A command a follower sends is named by the record's position too, so two records' commands are two commands: memory's RedeliveryAddsNothing.

mutants.name: dk3-cursor-only-forward
mutants.rule: The last save wins, behind the one before too (a projection rebuilt from the start): Cursor.LastSaveWins. Follow only moves forward, so RedeliveryAddsNothing does not see it.

mutants.name: dk3-cursor-per-stream
mutants.from: func placeOf(follower string, stream string) Place { Place{Follower: follower, Stream: stream} }
mutants.to: func placeOf(follower string, stream string) Place { Place{Follower: "", Stream: stream} }
mutants.rule: A follower's cursor is its own: Cursor.CursorsAreApart. One follower alone, as in RedeliveryAddsNothing, does not see it.

mutants.name: dk5-keep-opens-entry
mutants.rule: Keep keeps the entry, so the state's timer is not started again (runtime.md 9.2): KeepKeepsTheTimer.

mutants.name: mq-keep-loses-receipt
mutants.from: Tell[Ledger[S, E], Receipt]{Next: Ledger[S, E]{Stream: l.Stream, State: next, Position: r.Position, Receipts: l.Receipts.Put(id, r), Last: Recorded[E]{Position: r.Position, ID: id, Events: events}}, Output: r}
mutants.to: Tell[Ledger[S, E], Receipt]{Next: Ledger[S, E]{Stream: l.Stream, State: next, Position: r.Position, Receipts: l.Receipts.Put(id, r), Last: Recorded[E]{Position: r.Position, ID: id, Events: events}}, Output: Receipt{ID: id, Stream: l.Stream, Position: 0}}
mutants.rule: Keep gives the step's receipt as its Tell output, which Send returns: KeepKeepsTheTimer.

mutants.name: dk5-stepid-constant
mutants.rule: Each record a StepID names has its own id, so the log keeps every step: StepIDsReplay.
